audit.whatIsWrong: Four places claim Pantheon's PASSIVE blocks your autos ('his passive blocks your auto', 'passive auto-block', 'blocks my first auto', 'Use his passive to block your first auto').
audit.why: Mortal Will reads 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered' — it is an empowerment, not a block. The blocking is Aegis Assault (E): he sets his shield and is invulnerable to damage from the FRONT. Players told to fear a passive block will never learn the one that matters.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault is never mentioned anywhere on the page, and it is the ability that decides extended trades.
audit.why: It is invulnerable to damage from the front only, on a 22s rank-1 cooldown — the longest in his kit. Jousting recast dashes you back THROUGH him, which is exactly how you end up behind the shield instead of hammering its face.

edits.before: Level 1 is the one window I respect — Pantheon's passive blocks my first auto, his W is a point-click stun, and his empowered Q spear pokes Skaarl's health bar while I have nothing spammable to answer. Don't walk into a level-1 fight; soak the wave and keep my mount health high. The lane flips the instant I hit 2: Violent Tendencies (W) gives me the on-hit shotgun shots, and at 3 the full E-W-E re-E combo plus Skaarl's free health bar wins almost any short trade he wants. Bait his W stun first, then E in, Bear Trap (Q) for the slow and percent-HP, and yank in with the recast.
edits.after: Level 1 is the one window I respect — Shield Vault is a point-click stun, Mortal Will empowers his next cast, and Comet Spear pokes Skaarl's health bar while I have nothing spammable to answer. Don't walk into a level-1 fight; soak the wave and keep my mount health high. The lane flips the instant I hit 2: Violent Tendencies (W) gives me the on-hit shotgun shots, and at 3 the full E-W-E re-E combo plus Skaarl's free health bar wins almost any short trade he wants. If he sets Aegis Assault, recast E through him — that shield only blocks the front.

notes: Aegis Assault is tagged 'channel — interruptible, any CC cancels it' in the kit file, but Riot's own text does not say the channel can be broken. Kled's Bear Trap yank cancelling Aegis Assault would be the single most valuable line in this matchup, so it is worth confirming: I did not write it, because it rests on a derived flag rather than the description. What I did write — that the shield is invulnerable from the front only, and that Jousting's recast dashes you back through him — comes straight from both descriptions.
